metadata.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.2 (seed excerpt)
metadata.remarks: SEED DATA: abbreviated paraphrase for offline development and tests, not the official text. Run src/scripts/ingest_catalogs.py to replace with the published OSCAL content.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and distribute an access control policy and procedures to {{ insert: param, ac-01_odp.01 }}, and review them on a defined schedule.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Access control policy and procedures address the controls in the AC family.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Define the types of system accounts allowed: {{ insert: param, ac-02_odp.01 }}. Assign account managers, require approvals, and monitor account use.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Account types include individual, shared, group, system, guest, and temporary accounts.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Support the management of system accounts using automated mechanisms.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Automated mechanisms include email or text notifications and automatic disabling of inactive accounts.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Allow only authorized accesses for users and processes that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Least privilege applies to privileged and non-privileged accounts.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identify the types of events the system can log: {{ insert: param, au-02_odp.01 }}. Coordinate the logging function with other entities needing audit information.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: An event is an observable occurrence in a system. Logging supports incident response and accountability.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that identification with processes acting on their behalf.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Organizational users include employees and individuals the organization treats as employees.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement multi-factor authentication for access to privileged accounts.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Multi-factor authentication combines two or more different authentication factors.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Conduct a risk assessment, document the results, and update the assessment {{ insert: param, ra-03_odp.01 }}.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Risk assessments consider threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, and impact.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal managed interfaces.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Managed interfaces include gateways, routers, firewalls, and encrypted tunnels.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of {{ insert: param, sc-28_odp.01 }} at rest.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Information at rest is information located on a storage device in a system.
